hook.name: LeveragedLiquidityHook
hook.description: A JIT-liquidity hook for Morpho-backed leveraged tokens. Each swap atomically mints or redeems vault positions via a primary hook, installs a transaction-scoped concentrated liquidity position sized to match the swap, executes through the pool, then removes it in afterSwap. External liquidity additions are blocked; swaps use a dynamic fee override at a fixed 30 bps protocol charge.
